conditional_label_finding: Nonignored zero is known background in the objective; bias follows only if actual zero voxels include missing/unannotated organs, which this review has not established
checkpoint_selection_clarification: If gold_standard_cases is supplied, it becomes validation and its mean_dice selects checkpoints; separate optional rad_cases true_dice is logged, not selected directly. Historical branch/config requires run records.
clinical_and_patient_specific_claims: Not established by programmed curves, same-segmenter agreement or global image similarity alone; no universal impossibility claim for NCCT synthesis
